long.thesis: The multiples are low and the profits are already there. Wait for this selloff to turn back up before you buy.
Safety could be the next memecoin. Low volatility and staples should hold up if the AI trade cracks.
Healthcare is where the jobs are. Demand stays steady whether or not the AI cycle does.
Banks and asset managers are not very exposed to the AI trade. They should keep making steady profits whether or not it falls apart.
When you are more likely to lose money than make it, there is no shame in parking money for a while in liquid bond ETFs.

short.thesis: Debt-heavy builders such as CoreWeave and TeraWulf are the most at risk. Even lower-debt names such as IREN and Nebius look extremely overvalued, and the backstops under this buildout are on shaky ground.

short.sector: Crypto miners turned AI data centers
short.thesis: Failed miners pivoting to AI hosting carry the buildout risk without the track record.
Capex is too high, and the earnings growth showing up now does not look sustainable. Oracle is the debt-heavy one.
The short is the debt-heavy side of autos: manufacturers, parts, anything in that chain.
A big slowdown in home sales hits iBuyers and housing tech the hardest.
